patch.value: GH-1551: expose omission and budget receipts on precise SDK read results

Public list, context, search and get first-page types omit runtime omission_receipt and optional default-budget receipts. Preserve precise required fields, option-sensitive whole-result omissions and producer continuations while exposing the shared public receipt contracts.

Root and query entrypoint consumers can inspect omission_receipt on list/context/search/get without casts; Default-budget read_output and output_budget_truncation are optional and typed; Explicit budget/session/cursor omission and sparse producer page narrowing remain sound; Packed declarations compile with the runtime receipt shapes.
